name: navbar
title: Navbar
description: The top bar of a public site: brand, up to five links, actions and a language choice, collapsing into a menu on phones.

when: The main navigation of a marketing or public site.

builtIn: The brand link is named for the home page.
youProvide: A `brandLabel` when the brand alone does not say where it goes.
With children: an id on every NavbarItem (currentKey matches it), or isCurrent on the page's link.

Navbar.name: brand
Navbar.description: The logo and wordmark (the site's logo). It links to `brandHref`. Or a `NavbarBrand` child.

Navbar.name: brandHref
Navbar.description: Where the brand goes: the home page.

Navbar.name: brandLabel
Navbar.description: The brand link's name when the brand alone does not say where it goes ("Acme home").

Navbar.name: links
Navbar.description: Up to five destinations. Leave it out to compose `NavbarItem`s as children instead.

Navbar.name: children
Navbar.description:
With no `links`: `NavbarItem`s (the destinations), plus an optional `NavbarBrand` (instead of `brand`) and
`NavbarActions` (instead of `actions`).

Navbar.name: currentKey
Navbar.description: The link of the page (or section) in view: marked `aria-current="page"`.

Navbar.name: actions
Navbar.description:
At the end: a language switcher, sign-in (subtle), then the one primary action, the same on every page. On
phones they move into the menu panel, under the links. Or a `NavbarActions` child.

Navbar.name: isSticky
Navbar.description: Pinned to the top while the page scrolls.

Navbar.name: density
Navbar.description: `compact`: 48px instead of 56px, the bar after the hero.

Navbar.name: aria-label
Navbar.description: Names the navigation landmark; "Main menu" by default.

NavbarBrand.name: children
NavbarBrand.description: The logo and wordmark; it links to the Navbar's `brandHref`.

NavbarItem.name: href
NavbarItem.description: A page or an in-page anchor ("/#pricing"); it goes through the host router.

NavbarItem.name: children
NavbarItem.description: A noun for the place ("Pricing"), never a verb.

NavbarItem.name: isCurrent
NavbarItem.description: Marks this link as the page in view, instead of the Navbar's `currentKey`.

NavbarActions.name: children
NavbarActions.description: A language switcher, sign-in (subtle), then the one primary action.
